snippet.title: Another Bar Game
snippet.description:
An upcoming casual action game where you serve craft beer to thirsty bar guests. Become the most popular bartender in town! Wash glasses, clean tables and keep everybody happy! From the creator of Dude, Where Is My Beer?

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216060/Another_Bar_Game/
